Arapuni.metered: Before April 2011 the metered history has one figure for the whole station, under ARI1101. ARI1102 has its own figure from then, so the split by grid connection starts there.

Cobb.metered: At this point metered generation is net of local load, about 35% of Cobb's gross output. Where the embedded generation meter reads more, we add the difference.

Deep Stream (Waipori A).metered: Since June 2011 one meter (WPG0331) carries Deep Stream and Mahinerangi wind farm together. The metered history splits it 30% Deep Stream, 70% Mahinerangi, their average shares in the dispatch data 2020–26. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) has each plant's own output.

Fonterra Dairy - Whareroa.metered: At this point metered generation is net of local load, about 50% of Whareroa's gross output. Where the embedded generation meter reads more, we add the difference.

Glenbrook Steel.metered:
The register lists it as gas. We show it as waste heat: it runs on waste gas and heat from NZ Steel's ironmaking, not pipeline gas.
Its metered output (meter points GLN0111 and GLN0332) runs about 1.47 times the dispatch data's figure, so expect a step where the metered history meets the dispatch weeks.

Highbank.metered: It has no metered rows before October 2001, and its rows read next to nothing until April 2002.

Huntly 5.metered: September 2020: Generation_MD has no Huntly that month, so the history uses the grid meter for the whole station, split between units by their offers.

Huntly 6.metered: September 2020: Generation_MD has no Huntly that month, so the history uses the grid meter for the whole station, split between units by their offers.

Huntly Rankines.metered:
Shown as Coal/gas: units 1, 2 and 4 can burn coal or gas, and the market data doesn't say which.
The metered history has one meter for units 1–4 together, so it shows them as one. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) shows each unit.
September 2020: Generation_MD has no Huntly that month, so the history uses the grid meter for the whole station, split between units by their offers.

Kaimai.metered: Its one dispatched unit, Kaimai 5, carries the whole scheme, so we show it under the scheme's name.

Kaiwaikawe Wind Farm.metered: It isn't in the EA's plant register yet, so we add it from its dispatched unit (MPE1101 KWK0).

aka: Carter Holt Harvey Energy Ltd CoGen
Kawerau (Onepu).metered: This meter is a whole site's grid connection, not one generator's. It counts power going into the grid there, so it leaves out what the site uses itself and the power it takes from the grid at the same time. Generation_MD has no row for it before 2020, so 2013–2019 use the same figure from the grid meter (Grid_import). The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) reads higher.

Kawerau (TOPP2).metered: Since December 2025 one metered code at KAW2201 carries TOPP2 and Te Ahi O Maui together. The metered history splits it 65% TOPP2, 35% Te Ahi O Maui, by their shares in the dispatch data. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) has each plant's own output.

Kawerau (Te Ahi O Maui).metered: Since December 2025 one metered code at KAW2201 carries Te Ahi O Maui and TOPP2 together. The metered history splits it 35% Te Ahi O Maui, 65% TOPP2, by their shares in the dispatch data. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) has each plant's own output.

Kinleith.metered: The register lists it as gas. We show it as bioenergy: Oji Fibre Solutions' cogeneration runs on wood waste and black liquor, with natural gas as a secondary fuel.

Kōwhai Park Solar Farm.metered: It isn't in the EA's plant register yet, so we add it from its dispatched unit (ISL0661 KPS0).

Mahinerangi (Waipori B).metered: Since June 2011 one meter (WPG0331) carries Mahinerangi and Deep Stream hydro together. The metered history splits it 70% Mahinerangi, 30% Deep Stream, their average shares in the dispatch data 2020–26. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) has each plant's own output.

Mangahao.metered: At this point metered generation is net of local load, about 10% of Mangahao's gross output. Where the embedded generation meter reads more, we add the difference.

Matahina.metered: Metered generation has no rows for Matahina from October 2021, so dispatch figures stand in.

Mill Creek.metered: Its first 16 months, May 2014 to August 2015, aren't in metered generation or embedded generation. They come from Meridian's injection at Wilton in the reconciliation data.

Ngāwhā.metered: The metered history counts the whole station (Ngāwhā A and B). The dispatch data has only Ngāwhā B (OEC4), so in the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month, the rest of the station is filled in as a calculated estimate.

Pātea.metered: The dispatch data has three units, which we show as one plant to match the metered history. It moved from connection HWA1101 to OHG1101 in June 2026.

Roxburgh.metered: It generates onto two buses (ROX2201 and ROX1101), so it can be split by grid connection.

Ruakākā Solar Farm.metered: It isn't in the EA's plant register yet, so we add it from its dispatched unit (BRB0331 RUS0).

Southdown.metered: The metered history has one meter for the original cogeneration plant and unit 5 together. Southdown closed in January 2016, before the dispatch data starts.

Southdown Battery.metered: Generation_MD keeps the old station's code (SWN2201, "southdown", gas) for the battery after the station closed, so the metered history counts it as the battery from 2016. Its output there starts in September 2018. Before the dispatch data starts (10 Sep 2020) the history has its discharge only, not its charging.

Stratford.metered: The metered history has one meter (SFD2201) for Taranaki Combined Cycle (1998–2025) and the two peakers (from 2011), and until 2001 the old Stratford gas turbines too, so it shows the station whole. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) shows each unit.

Te Mihi.metered: The metered history has Te Mihi 1 and 2 together, so it shows the station whole. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) shows each unit.

Teviot.metered: The metered history has Teviot's own meter. It is never dispatched, so in the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month, its output is a calculated estimate from its typical day.

Waikaremoana.metered: The metered history has one meter for Tuai, Piripaua and Kaitawa together, so it shows the scheme whole. The dispatch data (the live week and the weeks since the newest metered month) shows each station.

West Wind.metered: It generates onto two buses (WWD1102 and WWD1103), so it can be split by grid connection. The dispatch data's West Wind 1 and 2 are one wind farm.
